requires.desc: Human Gate A approval note — R3 must not start before Gate A

invariants.text: Every claim ID across the 7 era records and adspend.json has exactly one verdict in verdicts.json; verdicts are in {confirmed, adjusted, rejected, unverified}; unverified count is zero.

Every adjusted verdict records old value, new value, and reason, and the new calibration object is complete; every rejected claim is removed from or replaced in its source record; no rejected claim ID survives unchanged.

Verdicts show independent verification, not citation-echo: confirmations cite the verifier's independently located source, and disagreements between verifier and researcher are recorded, not averaged away.
invariants.instructions: Sample at least 3 confirmed verdicts per era batch. A confirmation whose only evidence is the claim's own cited source violates this invariant. Check adjusted/rejected entries for midpoint-averaging of conflicting sources — that also violates.

invariants.text: The disagreement log is preserved and the era records + adspend.json reflect all adjustments (post-remediation state matches verdicts).
